name: looperators-agent-loop-p0
description: P0 compatibility probe for SessionFlow Agent Loop hooks, inline views, and MCP Apps.

interface.shortDescription: Probe and visualize a local Agent Loop.
interface.longDescription: A deliberately small compatibility experiment for collecting Codex hook events, rendering a thread-scoped inline graph, and exposing the same graph through an MCP App.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-loop-visualization to normalize the local P0 hook log and render the SessionFlow Agent Loop graph.
